description: Checks up to 200 frames of a screen's layout against a device's measured window: whether each frame reaches outside the window, into a safe-area inset, past the display's rounded corner, under the status bar or the app's top or bottom tab bar, across a foldable's fold, or into a reserved region such as a camera. Each finding gives its numbers; a frame near a rounded corner gets the concentric radius. Frames are in the device's unit, in window coordinates from the top left. Without screen, a foldable is checked on its first screen, closed (the cover display). Orientation and rotation must agree when both are given. The request body is at most 64 KiB, so keep frame names short.

device.description: A device id from list_devices, such as iphone-17 or pixel-8.

orientation.description: The window shape; the reading at rotation 0 when neither this nor rotation is given.

rotation.description: The device's rotation; 90 puts its top edge on the window's left.

runtime.description: A runtime build such as 24A434, or a version such as 27.2 or 16, written exactly as list_devices gives it (27.0, not 27). A version names the device's current build when it is the current version, else that version's newest release build. The device's current build when omitted.

screen.description: A foldable's pose: closed, open, half-open or tent; every other device has main only. A foldable's first screen, closed, when omitted.

name: check_layout

corners.description: Corner radii for the reading's orientation, with where they come from.

prerelease.description: A pre-release build; never a device's `current`.

bar.description: status: the system status bar. navigation: the app's top bar, UINavigationBar with an inline title or Material 3's TopAppBar. tab: the app's bottom tab bar, UITabBar or Material 3's NavigationBar.

concentricRadius.description: The corner radius that keeps an even gap to the display's corner: its radius minus the frame's larger distance from the two edges, at most half the frame's shorter side.

depth.description: How far the frame reaches into the inset, past the curve, or under the bar.

gap.description: The frame corner's distance inside the display's curve.

screen.description: A foldable's pose: closed, open, half-open or tent; every other device has main only.

title: Check a layout against a device
